scenario: Clock position shift + BI-RADS category change + node negative as a status flip + two right breast negatives
description: Built from breast-mg/findings_{gt,pred}/example_1 (constructed diagnostic mammogram for a palpable lump). The spiculated mass is matched although the pred places it at 10 instead of 2 o'clock (no gt mass at 10 o'clock); the calcifications are matched whatever category each side gives; the pred node negative is matched to the suspicious node it denies (status flip, INC downstream); two right breast negatives match.

user.indication: 47-year-old woman with a palpable lump in the left breast.

pred_findings.text: Heterogeneously dense breasts (ACR breast density c).

New irregular mass with spiculated margins and no associated calcifications in the left breast at 10 o'clock, upper inner quadrant, middle depth, 5 cm from the nipple, measuring 1.6 x 1.4 cm, corresponding to the palpable lump, highly suggestive of malignancy, BI-RADS 5.
New grouped punctate calcifications spanning 5 mm in the left breast at 6 o'clock, 4 cm from the nipple, BI-RADS 3.
No suspicious left axillary lymph nodes.
No mammographic evidence of malignancy in the right breast.

gt_findings.text: Heterogeneously dense breasts (ACR breast density c).

New irregular mass with spiculated margins and no associated calcifications in the left breast at 2 o'clock, upper outer quadrant, middle depth, 5 cm from the nipple, measuring 1.6 x 1.4 cm, corresponding to the palpable lump, highly suggestive of malignancy, BI-RADS 5.
New grouped punctate calcifications spanning 5 mm in the left breast at 6 o'clock, 4 cm from the nipple, BI-RADS 4A.
Enlarged dense left axillary lymph node measuring 2.1 cm with loss of the fatty hilum, suspicious for metastasis.
No mammographic evidence of malignancy in the right breast, with no suspicious mass, calcifications or architectural distortion.

matches.reasoning: One new spiculated left breast mass at the palpable lump, placed at 10 vs 2 o'clock.
Same new grouped punctate calcifications at 6 o'clock, assessed differently.
'No suspicious left axillary lymph nodes' denies the enlarged suspicious node.
Both rule out malignancy in the right breast.
